tasks.gr11-prescribed-prose-poetry-t1: Topic: Prescribed prose/folklore and poetry for Grade 11 English HL. Cover engagement with prescribed texts using mature literary terminology, device identification, theme support, and contextual literature responses. Ask learners to identify literary devices in given passages, explain how devices create meaning, match quotations to themes, write contextual responses, and distinguish between folklore conventions and prose fiction.
tasks.gr11-literary-devices-theme-t1: Topic: Literary devices and theme in Grade 11 English HL. Cover the identification and effect of devices such as metaphor, simile, personification, irony, alliteration, onomatopoeia, allusion, enjambment, and oxymoron. Ask learners to name and explain devices in extracts, describe how a device creates a particular effect, track a theme across multiple stanzas or paragraphs, write a well-structured analytical paragraph, and distinguish between theme and subject.
tasks.gr11-process-writing-fet-genres-t1: Topic: Process writing for FET essay and transactional genres in Grade 11 English HL. Cover narrative, descriptive, argumentative, reflective, and discursive essays, as well as formal letters, CVs, and covering letters. Ask learners to identify the correct essay type for a given purpose, apply the stages of process writing (plan, draft, review, revise, edit), select the correct register for different transactional tasks, structure a formal letter correctly, and distinguish between argumentative and discursive essays.
tasks.gr11-listening-language-context-t1: Topic: Listening comprehension and language in context for Grade 11 English HL. Cover listening recall, comprehension inference, unprepared speech techniques, and language paper skills including grammar and editing. Ask learners to answer factual and inferential listening questions, correct grammar errors in edited passages, convert between direct and indirect speech, identify and name parts of speech, and explain how language choices affect meaning.
